bio.text: Ndidiamaka "Didi" Okpareke is the Republican candidate for New Mexico's 1st Congressional District in the November 3, 2026 general election, against Rep. Melanie Stansbury.
She is a compounding pharmacist in Rio Rancho and has run her own compounding pharmacy there for nearly 10 years.
She was born and raised in California's Bay Area and moved to Albuquerque in the late 1990s; her parents immigrated to the U.S. from Nigeria.
